manufacturer_checks.result: Datasheet p12:NC 10,15,19,20 must float. p24 land drawing shaded 19/20 region prohibits PCB metal/via electrical or mechanical contact. These are not thermal pads; existing no-land assignment is intentional and should remain. Parent reports B.Cu footprint keepout exists.

Table 6 p13 calls EPAD VSS control logic ground; Table 7 p14 connects all MCU VSS/VSSA to exposed pad. p5 note 2 requires grounds connected. Need short local low-impedance plane connection; no numerical minimum via count found in local datasheet. θJA48.3C/W p7 is for 114.3 x 76.2 mm JEDEC 2s2p, not current compact PCB.

Current schematic/PCB ties pin 5 NC to IO2; local datasheet p3 explicitly says pin 5 not internally connected. This differs from Oct 6 preserved review which left 5 unconnected; no functional pinout mismatch found. Pins 1,2,4 IO; 3 GND; 6 VCC match DRY table.
Current native/PCB pin 1 TXD, 2 GND, 3 VCC, 4 RXD, 5 VIO, 6 CANL, 7 CANH, 8 STB, 9 EP=GND match Oct 6 reviewed mapping; current whole-board pin/net comparison passes.

false_positive_triage: PP-001 bootstrap DC-path errors U201 BOOT and U4 BOOT1/2/3 do not model internal bootstrap charging paths; no added resistor/rail tie required. LMR36510 p3 requires BOOT-SW 100 nF; STSPIN feature list and bootstrap section describe embedded diodes.
USB_DM/DP VM-001 errors misclassify USB ESD rail as 5 V logic; do not add USB level shifters.
EXT_SENSOR_FAULT_N VM-001 is open-drain with R604 pull-up to 3V3; no 5 V push-pull crossing.
U205 PG is intentionally NC; no pull-up needed unless used. U601 MISO pull-up not mandatory.
RS-001 10V_FB,10V_GOOD,PWR_SOURCE_STATUS,VBUS_SENSE are signals; VBUS_MUX_IN source is via retained power path. No missing rail generators inferred.
SS-001 procurement flag not promoted into layout blocker; exact passive procurement is separate from this requested layout review.
U20519/20 native parity messages are intentional documented NC/no-copper exceptions, not missing GND thermal pads.
